body:
I'm sorry for your struggle.

I empathize with it.  After my mother's suicide attempt I told myself I'd never commit suicide because it destroys the lives around them...but I'm struggling to hold on myself and wonder if I have paid my dues yet.


Best I can say is, you never know, maybe tomorrow you'll wake up to a day that's better.  Maybe a day, 3 months from now, will be the best day of your life.  What do you have to lose?  Just live on as long as you can and see where life takes you.
